blocks.text:
At Rio de Janeiro International Airport, your driver will meet you and transfer you to your hotel.

The rest of the day is free. You can use it to rest after your flight or begin exploring the city.

Rio is surrounded by green hills, bays, islands, and beaches. Copacabana, Ipanema, and Leblon are particularly famous for their black-and-white tiled promenades.

From early morning until evening, people play football and volleyball on the beaches. Active visitors can enjoy golf, tennis, surfing, rafting, diving, hang gliding, and other activities.

Open-air beach cafés serve coconut water, freshly squeezed juices, and other drinks. You may also come across local musicians along the waterfront.

If your hotel is on the coast or by Guanabara Bay, you can spend your first evening by the water without booking an excursion. This is a convenient day for the group to adjust after the flight before the congress program begins.

A welcome drink is arranged for the group.
